description: This file contains a repository class 'TransactionRepository' providing data access methods for 'Transaction' objects in a database. It includes CRUD operations and list querying functionalities tailored for transaction management within an expense tracking application.

classes.name: TransactionRepository
classes.description: Data access layer for Transaction related database operations, including create, read, update, delete, and list functions with filtering and sorting.
